hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that routes swaps entirely through Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it takes the input token into an Euler vault, withdraws the output token from another Euler vault, and returns the full BeforeSwapDelta to the PoolManager — bypassing Uniswap's CLAMM entirely and enforcing a custom curve invariant (CurveLib.verify) on reserves.
